transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, ConversalQ support. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I've called three times about this billing issue and nobody has fixed it. I want to speak to a real person RIGHT NOW. Not a bot.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your frustration and I sincerely apologize for the repeated experience. You deserve better than this. I'm escalating you to a senior human agent right now — you won't have to re-explain your issue.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Finally. Every time I call I have to start from scratch. It's exhausting.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's completely unacceptable and I hear you. I'm attaching a full summary of your previous interactions to your case so the senior agent has full context before they speak with you. Your case reference is CASE-20260513-4471.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: OK. How long will this take?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A senior agent will call you back within 15 minutes at the number you're calling from. You'll also receive a confirmation SMS with the case number. Would you prefer to hold or receive a callback?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Confirmed. Callback within 15 minutes. Case number CASE-20260513-4471. Is there anything immediate I can note down to help the senior agent?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes — I was charged for a plan I never requested. It's been happening for 3 months and I want a full 3-month refund.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've logged that clearly: unauthorized plan charge for 3 months, full refund requested. The senior agent will review this as a priority. Thank you for your patience, and again I'm sorry for the trouble you've experienced.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: OK. I'll wait for the call.
